Reviewer recommends rejection: Almost everything checks out, and the person_json facts (birth date, birthplace) are confirmed. Three fixes are needed before approval. (1) Cut or reword 'The company's first big hit came in 1999'. It is uncited, CHM only says 'one of NVIDIA's defining moments', and the RIVA 128 (1997) is generally seen as the first hit. (2) The body says NVIDIA 'marketed' the GeForce 256 as "the world's first graphics processing unit", and the summary says 'billed as'. That wording is CHM's own description, not a cited NVIDIA marketing claim. Either cite an NVIDIA source or attribute the description to the Computer History Museum. (3) Drop or source 'Huang has a habit of compressing that story into one claim'. It is an uncited characterisation. Optional: add inline citations to the FAQ answers. No outdated claims: the NVIDIA bio, fetched live today, still lists him as president and CEO.
